<title>Pronto Merchant Support</title>

<!-- branding stylesheets -->

<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/salesforce-lightning-design-system.min.css?{ versionKey }"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-site-spacing-styling-hooks.min.css?{ versionKey }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-styling-hooks.min.css?{ versionKey }" />

<style>
 /* General Footer Styles */
.slds-footer {
    background-color: #f3f3f3;
    padding: 40px 20px;
    font-family: 'Salesforce Sans', Arial, sans-serif;
}

.slds-footer-title {
    font-weight: bold;
    font-size: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    color: #16325c;
}

.slds-footer-section {
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.slds-footer-links {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
}

.slds-footer-links li {
    margin: 5px 0;
}

.slds-footer-links a {
    color: #0070d2;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 14px;
}

.slds-footer-links a:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
}

.slds-footer-copy {
    text-align: center;
    margin-top: 20px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #50575e;
}
    
        .slds-social-icons img {
        width: 24px;
        height: 24px;
          filter: saturate(500%) contrast(800%) brightness(500%) 
      invert(80%) sepia(50%) hue-rotate(120deg); 
    }


/* Header Styling */
.slds-header {
    background-color: transparent;
    font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
    padding: 10px 20px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #eaeaea;
}

.slds-header-logo img {
    max-height: 100px;
    height: auto;
    padding-top: 5px;
    padding-bottom: 5px;
}

/* Navigation Links */
.slds-header-nav {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center; /* Vertically align links within the header */
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    gap: 30px; /* Add spacing between navigation links */
}

.slds-header-nav li {
    margin: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center; /* Ensure text stays vertically aligned */
}

.slds-header-nav a {
    text-decoration: none;
    color: #1e4c82;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    transition: color 0.2s ease;
    line-height: 1; /* Ensure proper vertical alignment */
}

.slds-header-nav a:hover {
    color: #0070d2;
}
    
    .slds-header-logo img {
    max-height: 100px; /* Increased height for a larger logo */
    min-height:75px;
    height: auto;
    padding-top: 5px;
    padding-bottom: 5px;
}


/* Waffle Button */
.waffle-button {
    background: none;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 8px;
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
}

.waffle-icon {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 20px;
    height: 15px;
    position: relative;
}

.waffle-icon::before,
.waffle-icon::after,
.waffle-icon div {
    content: '';
    display: block;
    background-color: #333333;
    height: 3px;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 4px 0;
    border-radius: 2px;
}

/* Mobile Navigation */
#mobile-nav {
    background: #ffffff;
    padding: 10px 20px;
    border-top: 1px solid #eaeaea;
    display: none;
}

#mobile-nav a {
    color: #333333;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    font-weight: normal;
}

#mobile-nav a:hover {
    color: #0070d2;
}

/* Hero Section */
.hero {
    background: url("/sfsites/c/resource/prontosite/pronto-site/pronto-merchant-hero.png") no-repeat center center;
    background-size: cover;
    color: #16325c;
    padding: 60px 20px;
    font-family: 'Salesforce Sans', Arial, sans-serif;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    height: 400px;
    text-align: left;
}

/* Hero Content */
.hero__content {
    max-width: 600px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
    padding: 20px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
}

/* Hero Headline */
.hero__headline {
    font-size: 2.5rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}

/* Hero Subheadline */
.hero__subheadline {
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    margin-bottom: 30px;
    color: #5a6872;
}

/* CTA Button */
.hero__cta button {
    background-color: #35ba05;
    color: #ffffff;
    border: none;
    padding: 12px 20px;
    font-size: 1rem;
    border-radius: 5px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-weight: bold;
    transition: background-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
}

.hero__cta button:hover {
    background-color: #005fb2;
    transform: scale(1.05);
}

/* Responsive Adjustments */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .hero {
        height: auto; /* Adjust height for mobile */
        padding: 40px 15px;
        flex-direction: column; /* Stack content vertically */
        align-items: center; /* Center content horizontally */
        text-align: center; /* Center align text */
    }

    .hero__content {
        max-width: 100%; /* Full width on mobile */
        padding: 15px; /* Adjust padding for smaller screens */
        text-align: center;
    }

    .hero__headline {
        font-size: 2rem; /* Smaller font size for mobile */
    }

    .hero__subheadline {
        font-size: 1rem; /* Adjust font size for mobile */
        margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .hero__cta button {
        padding: 10px 15px; /* Adjust button padding for mobile */
        font-size: 0.9rem;
    }
}


/* Quick Links Section */
.quick-links {
    padding: 30px 10px;
    background-color: #fef9f4;
    font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
    text-align: center;
}

.quick-links__title {
    font-size: 1.75rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #4d4d4d;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.quick-links__grid {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 20px;
    justify-content: center;
}

.quick-links__card {
    background-color: #ffffff;
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    max-width: 320px;
    min-height: 360px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-align: left;
}

.quick-links__card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-5px);
    box-shadow: 0 6px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
}

.quick-links__image img {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
}

.quick-links__header {
    padding: 15px;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #4d4d4d;
}

.quick-links__body {
    padding: 0 15px;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    color: #6d6d6d;
    flex-grow: 1;
}

.quick-links__footer {
    padding: 10px;
    background-color: #f7f7f7;
    text-align: center;
}

.quick-links__footer a {
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #ff6f61;
    text-decoration: none;
    display: inline-block;
}

.quick-links__footer a:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
}

/* Help Section */
.support-section {
    padding: 20px 10px;
    background-color: #fef9f4;
    font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
    text-align: center;
}

.support-section__title {
    font-size: 1.6rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #333333;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.support-section__subtitle {
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: #666666;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.support-grid {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 15px;
    justify-content: center;
}

.support-card {
    background-color: #f9f9f9;
    border: 1px solid #dddddd;
    border-radius: 8px;
    max-width: 600px;
    padding: 15px;
    text-align: center;
    flex: 1;
}

.support-card__icon {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.support-card__header {
    font-size: 1.3rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #333333;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.support-card__body {
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: #555555;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
    line-height: 1.5;
}

.support-card__footer a {
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #0070d2;
    text-decoration: none;
}

.support-card__footer a:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
}

/* Knowledge Section */
.knowledge-section {
    padding: 30px 15px;
    background-color: #ffffff;
    font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
    text-align: left;
}

.knowledge-section__title {
    font-size: 1.6rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #333333;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    text-align: center;
}

.knowledge-section__subtitle {
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: #666666;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    text-align: center;
}

.knowledge-grid {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 40px;
    justify-content: center;
}

.knowledge-column {
    flex: 1;
    max-width: 300px;
}

.knowledge-column__header {
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #333333;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #35ba05;
    padding-bottom: 5px;
}

.knowledge-column__list {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
}

.knowledge-column__list-item {
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.knowledge-column__list-item a {
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: #0070d2;
    text-decoration: none;
}

.knowledge-column__list-item a:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
}

.knowledge-column__footer {
    margin-top: 15px;
}

.knowledge-column__footer a {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #ff6f61;
    text-decoration: none;
}

.knowledge-column__footer a:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
}

/* Responsive Design */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .slds-header {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
    }

    .slds-header-nav {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 10px;
    }

    .quick-links__card,
    .support-card,
    .knowledge-column {
        flex: 1 1 100%;
        max-width: 100%;
    }

    .knowledge-grid {
        gap: 20px;
    }

    .knowledge-section,
    .quick-links {
        padding: 20px;
    }
}



</style>
